data.body:
Final report — merged Gerrit 1773 at ead96799ce.

Problem: 884 real Pandoc conversion assertions also performed 883 redundant repository-root subprocesses.
Proven root cause: `_convert` resolved `_pandoc_timeout()` per unit; `load_config()` performed root discovery before its result-cache lookup.
Proof: old 884-unit trace = 1,770 Popen calls (884 Pandoc + 886 git-root), 29.2378s. Repaired trace = 887 Popen calls (884 Pandoc + 3 cold root probes), 29.0194s. Exact bytes matched; all 884 Pandoc calls remained. This confirmed the lookup mechanism but measured only 0.2184s quiet-host savings, so it is not a material wall-clock RCA.
Test: held-out three-unit resolution-count oracle was RED at 3 resolutions, GREEN at 1, exact defect seed returned RED at 4, then GREEN after restoration. Focused renderer suite: 90 passed.
Fix: sample timeout once per render pass and thread it through optional private-helper parameters; direct callers retain safe defaults.
Scope/safety: sole production caller and direct test callers were swept; no caller depends on lookup count. No new dependency, no assertion/test removal, no byte/fallback/timeout/reap behavior change.
Siblings: no other production caller or parallel surface was missing the invariant.
Residual risk: accepted — real Pandoc corpus work remains expensive by explicit ADR 0095 coverage contract; tracked by the CI-runtime umbrella for separate evidence-based remediation.
Replication: Gerrit Verify run 31791259529 passed in 33m43s; LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, zero unresolved comments. macOS default suite was 26m39s and still performed every assertion.
OSS comparison: Django LazySettings, Black configuration/mode passing, and pytest session-scoped Config all resolve loop/session invariants once (3/3 consensus). Back-out: Gerrit revert of 1773.
